'''Michael''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] who lived in the last [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], he served as an [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] at the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|main hangar]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. The same year, Naboo was [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|subjugated]] by the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|forces]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. The engineers were taken [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] in their hangar until the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] destroyed the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s that guarded them. When Kenobi yelled at them, "Go!", Michael and his colleagues vacated the premises without looking back.<ref name="TPM" />

==Personality and traits==
Michael was a fair-skinned man with [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="FF" /> As a Naboo engineer, he wore a yellow, double-breasted [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]].<ref name="TPM" /> Like some of his colleagues, including [[Simon Jabesq|Simon]]<ref name="E1VG">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and [[Bernie Jabesq]],<ref name="E1:IG">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref> he had written his name in [[Futhork/Legends|futhork]],<ref name="FF" /> the informal Naboo script,<ref name="CVG">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> on his [[Armor/Legends|helmet]].<ref name="FF" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Michael_Futhork.png|thumb|left|Michael (left) with other engineers and guards, as shown in ''The Official Star Wars Fact File'']]
Michael first appeared as background character in the [[1999]] movie [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], the first installment of the [[prequel trilogy]], in which he was portrayed by an unidentified extra.<ref name="TPM" /> As with many other members of the Naboo Security Forces,<ref name="E1VG" /><ref name="E1:IG" /> his name was written on his helmet using the Futhork alphabet.<ref name="FF" /> Although the name was too blurry to be read in the movie itself,<ref name="TPM" /> a still photograph showcased in the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 133|133rd issue]] of ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'' allowed to decipher it properly.<ref name="FF" />
